text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":109,"why":"Patient confirmed checking temperature and fever is normal."},{"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":38,"why":"Patient explicitly stated no phlegm or blood in cough."},{"i":2,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":19,"why":"Patient mentioned having asthma as a child and using inhalers."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":58,"why":"Patient stated taking salbutamol every few weeks."},{"i":4,"v":"INFERRED","u":66,"why":"Patient implied needing inhaler during exercise."},{"i":5,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":72,"why":"Patient listed asthma and hay fever in past medical history."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":70,"why":"Patient confirmed taking salbutamol."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":85,"why":"Patient stated drinking one glass of wine every two or three days."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":91,"why":"Patient stated living with a partner."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":93,"why":"Patient stated working as an engineer."},{"i":10,"v":"INFERRED","u":105,"why":"Doctor's statement about asthma flare-up implies an exacerbation."},{"i":11,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":125,"why":"Doctor's advice to monitor temperature and call if worse supports this plan."}]}
